meta.title: Mirasol water chemistry
meta.units: µg/L; source reports ppb for water. No conversion of solid matrices.
meta.statistics: Descriptive summaries of analytical records within the selected channel, QA state, filtration, date and replicate filters. Multiple aliquots and reruns are retained; n is not a count of independent field visits.
meta.dates: Collection dates recovered from explicit sample labels or source workbook reference/dilution tables. Missing, ambiguous or future-relative-to-analysis dates stay unknown; analysis dates are separate.
meta.channels: Mass transition and gas mode remain separate. NG and No Gas spellings are harmonized; legacy #1/#2/#3 mode labels retain their original identity.
meta.qa: USE, REVIEW and EXCLUDE_PENDING_REVIEW are provisional inherited blank-screen dispositions, not validated water-safety classifications. No validated run-specific LLOQ; negative reported values are retained.
notes: No anion, pH, electrical conductivity, alkalinity, microbial or organic contaminant datasets were provided in the normalized database.
Coordinates and groundwater divide are approximate where digitized from the thesis; unmapped sites retain chemistry without invented coordinates.
